title: I’m an Epstein Survivor. MoMA Must Drop Leon Black.
summary: Institutions must reckon with the possibility that their prestige can be used to legitimize people whose conduct warrants serious investigations.

title: Vatican Exhibition Series Centers "Fundamentally Human" Art Over AI
summary: A triennale across seven cities expands on Pope Leo XIV's message that artificial intelligence models “lack the affective, relational and spiritual perspective” necessary to create art.

title: Beverly Buchanan at the Raw Edge of Art
summary: Instead of leaving the South behind, the polymath artist carried it into her writings, zines, paintings, and “shack sculptures” that echo the architecture of her childhood.

summary: Amid a cost-of-living crisis and the closure of local arts organizations, some are turning to different models to foster community, from nonprofit status to retail businesses.

title: Lisa Sanditz’s Seismic Sublime
summary: Her environmental paintings ask: What can we do to change our destiny? What effect can we have on the place we inhabit?

title: Cici Wu's Memory Lanterns
summary: Her flickering, hollow, and bandaged forms trace histories embodied across generations.

title: ​​Tacita Dean’s Truth in Materials
summary: Instead of the slick stream of internet and AI imagery, the moving pictures projected onto a 31-foot-tall column are insistently material.

title: Philadelphians to Vote on Permanent Arts and Culture Office on Election Day
summary: The proposed ballot measure would ensure that the office is immune from administrative overhauls.

title: Discover Marcel Duchamp at the Philadelphia Museum of Art
summary: See 300+ unique works by Marcel Duchamp, including the permanently installed masterpiece “Étant donnés”, exclusively at the Philadelphia Museum of Art.

title: University of Connecticut Offers a Funded MFA in Studio Art
summary: Develop your creative practice. Gain teaching experience. Join a community of artists and educators.

title: Remembering Ursula von Rydingsvard
summary: The monumental sculptor dies at 84; plus, how an artist snuck his own work into The Met, and a dispute over watercolors of Roma victims of the Holocaust.

title: The Artsiest Halloween Party in Town
summary: Hyperallergic’s spirited soirée, a bone to pick with “Costume Art” at The Met, and what’s a woman artist’s “prime” in the art world?

title: 10 Art Shows to See in Los Angeles This November
summary: Yuntao Xu’s art show in a gas station, LA’s first gallery run for and by Black artists, iris yirei hu’s reliquaries for a dream, and April Bey’s alien tapestries of human life.

title: Artist Sneaks His Work Into the Met Museum
summary: David Mitlaski says his oil pastel painting of the Met Gala captures “A-list celebrities prancing, while the world outside the museum gates is collapsing.”

title: How Mexican Photographers Made a Nation
summary: ​​A show at the Getty demonstrates the way modernist approaches to photography shifted the visual culture of Mexico in the 20th century.
